dedupe_keys.name: field survey data documenting flood damage to residential and economic activity buildings in the marche region italy

description: Politecnico di Milano and collaborating Italian universities and research institutes publish field-survey data on flood damage to buildings in the Marche region of Italy. The repository separates industrial-activity data from residential-building data in two ZIP archives. Its title identifies damage surveys as the resource, and the linked ESSD article documents the 2022 regional flood. The article-linked Zenodo address resolves to deposited version 1.0.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17457884. Access is open and free under CC-BY-4.0. The landing record contains no descriptive abstract, so sample counts, variable definitions, internal formats and precise survey dates were not established without opening the archives. These limitations affect immediate comparison with other surveys. Modellers could inspect the documented survey files when calibrating residential and business flood-loss simulations or checking recovery assumptions. This is an event-specific empirical collection, not a general national damage function. Its relation to other flood-loss datasets is methodological and requires checking common damage and exposure definitions.
